name: __aeabi_drdiv
comment: double reverse divide (swaps operands, calls ddiv)

name: __fpl_dcmp_InfNaN
comment: fplib: NaN handling for double compare

name: exit
comment: C exit -> __rt_exit (never reached: main does not return)

name: __ARM_common_switch8
comment: byte jump table helper: count byte at LR-1, offsets at LR; target=LR+2*off

name: FLASH_WaitForLastOperation
comment: wait BSY/CFGBSY with HAL_GetTick timeout; error in 0x2000265C

name: SystemClock_Config
comment: HSE 8 MHz -> PLL 64 MHz, 2 WS, AHB/APB /1, USART1/2 on PCLK

name: MX_GPIO_Init
comment: all plain GPIO (LCD ctrl, SPI flash CS, keys, PB0/PB1/PB2/PB7/PB12)

name: MX_SPI1_Init
comment: PA5/6/7 AF0, master mode 3, /2 = 32 MHz, 8 bit (SPI flash)

name: MX_TIM3_Init
comment: PSC 63, ARR 99 -> 10 kHz update IRQ, NVIC prio 0

name: keys_scan
comment: always debounces delay_loop(0x34155); returns key code 0..10 (PD0-3, PB3-5, PB11) (alias: key_scan)

name: spi1_xfer
comment: SPI1 full-duplex byte transfer with 101-poll TXE/RXNE timeouts

name: spiflash_write
comment: (buf, addr, len) splits into 256-byte page programs; no erase

name: spiflash_sector_erase
comment: WREN; wait; 0x20 + addr (4 KB); wait ready

name: spiflash_wait_ready
comment: 0x05, poll status bit0 (WIP) until 0, no timeout

name: uart3_putc
comment: USART3 TDR=byte, wait TC (called only from usart3_cmd_dispatch)

name: usart3_cmd_dispatch
comment: USART3 ':<a..l><num>\n' handler; switch8 table at 0x0800523A; replies 'Z'. The decompiler truncates it (real end 0x080054AA) (alias: factory_cmd_execute)

name: flash_ensure_rdp_level1
comment: if RDP level 0 -> program RDP level 1 (0xBB) and OB launch (reset) (alias: flash_ensure_rdp1)

name: vendor_licence_check
comment: 0x08003E00 = UID hash (write once); mismatch sets 0x20000010 bit10 (alias: flash_uid_binding_check, license_check_uid)

name: flash_settings_reset_if_flagged
comment: if u64@0x08003D00 != 0: erase SPI 0x74000+0x75000, program 0 (alias: factory_first_boot_wipe)

name: flash_write_word_3f00
comment: program {value,0} at 0x08003F00 if erased (USART reg 00) (alias: device_id_store_once)

name: store_settings_load
comment: SPI 0x74000 (32 x u16) -> 0x2000007E if word31==0x1F (alias: cal_load)

name: store_program_load
comment: (slot, ch) SPI 0x10000+slot*0x1000: 0x668 B + 800 B into ch1/ch2 RAM records (alias: program_load)

name: store_settings_restore_backup
comment: SPI 0x75000 -> RAM and rewrite 0x74000 if different (alias: cal_restore_backup)

name: store_settings_save
comment: (also_backup) write 0x2000007E block to 0x74000 (and 0x75000) if changed (alias: cal_save)

name: store_names_save
comment: erase 0x5000, write 0x780 B (entries 0 and 31 zeroed) (alias: names_save)

name: __heap_limit
comment: heap end / stack limit (stack 1 KB up to 0x20002CD0)

name: flashcfg_settings_reset
comment: bootloader page: u64 != 0 -> erase SPI settings at boot, then programmed 0 (alias: first_boot_flag)

name: vendor_reserved_3e00
comment: bootloader page: u64 UID-derived binding words (write once) (alias: flashcfg_uid_hash, license_key)

name: flashcfg_word_3f00
comment: bootloader page: u64 {value,0} from USART reg 00; not read by app (alias: device_id)

name: g_tim3_tick
comment: u8, +1 per TIM3 IRQ (100 us), low 4 bits = soft-PWM phase (alias: tick8)

name: g_tim3_sub101
comment: u8 0..100 cycle (10.1 ms); at 50 advances counters 0x20000024/28 (alias: elapsed_prescaler)

name: g_pb7_pwm_duty
comment: u8 0..16, PB7 soft-PWM duty (init 1; USART3 'b') (alias: pb7_pwm_duty)
